posts.author: Iohiko
posts.body: Hi everyone, I was looking for plugins that display a notification for the last item obtained, but the few I've found are either paid or don't work properly. If you know of any plugin that can do that, I'd appreciate it if you could recommend one. Otherwise, it would be great if you could tell me how I could build such a system myself. I was thinking of using a plugin that displays messages above the player, but I need to know if there’s a script that returns the last item obtained by the player so I can include it in the message. Thank you very much.

posts.author: rpgLord69
Solar_Flare
posts.body: This is something I've strongly considered doing myself. The only (minor?) problem is that not all instances of gainItem need an announcement – if you just got an item from a chest or something, sure, but if it's the result of a quest, the announcement is probably different and baked into the quest.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Iohiko said:
I was thinking of using a plugin that displays messages above the player, but I need to know if there’s a script that returns the last item obtained by the player so I can include it in the message.
Click to expand...
I don't think the core engine tracks "last item obtained" in any way. There might be a plugin for that? If the plugin you're considering permits variables, you could store an item's name in a variable, e.g.
Control Variables -> Script:
$dataArmors[123].name
Alternatively, there's a plugin named
TinyGetInfoWnd.js
: when the plugin's switch is on, a small, non-interrupting message shows at the top or bottom of the screen (configurable) whenever you gain/lose items/money. The message displays for a time, then disappears. It ships with the Steam version of RPG Maker MV (I assume it's also available for the standalone version). In the Steam version it can be found at:
<RPG Maker MV install folder>/dlc/KadokawaPlugins/TinyGetInfoWnd.js
